function.name: create_assignment
function.description: Creates and publishes or drafts a coursework/assignment (e.g. lab, homework, test) in Google Classroom. Can optionally include deadlines, max points, web links, or attached files. If course_id is unknown, invoke get_courses first.

description.description: Detailed instructions, requirements, or task descriptions.

max_points.description: Maximum points for this assignment (e.g. 10 or 100). Default is 100.

due_date.description: Deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-10-15'). If the user says 'до завтра' or gives a relative date, calculate it using get_current_time.

due_time.description: Deadline time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g. '23:59' or '18:00'). Optional.

links.description: List of web URLs to attach to the assignment (e.g. GitHub repos).

telegram_file_ids.description: List of telegram_file_id from user's messages to upload and attach.
